name: agent-lens
description: Work with the agent in one place: each edit checked against your CLAUDE.md as it is made and each turn's diff reviewed, the branch through lenses (/changes); the OpenSpec change read for you (/spec); the skill each prompt needs loaded for it (/router).

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of every part and of what its model answers: en or ru; /changes lang, /spec lang and /router lang override it

live.title: Rules while Claude edits
live.description: warn: check each edit against CLAUDE.md as it lands and tell Claude what it broke; block: check it before it lands and refuse it; off: leave the rules to the review after the turn

liveModel.title: Model for the edit check
liveModel.description: The model that checks each edit against the rules: an alias like haiku or a full model id

includeUserRules.title: Include ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
includeUserRules.description: Also check edits and reviews against your personal CLAUDE.md

includeUserLenses.title: Include ~/.claude/review-lenses.md
includeUserLenses.description: Also review the branch through your personal lenses, beside the mod's own and the project's LENSES.md

lenses.title: Lenses
lenses.description: off: the branch through lenses only on /changes lenses; offer: the row offers it once an OpenSpec change has every task ticked; auto: it runs by itself then, and before the agent pushes commits it has not read, its findings sent to Claude ahead of the push

specCritic.title: Critic for the spec
specCritic.description: An agent that reads the OpenSpec change against the code for holes. off; button: when you press f on Decide; auto: also after each turn that changes the change, sending what it finds to Claude to close, three rounds in a row at most. /spec critic overrides it

guard.title: Guard over each agent's turn
guard.description: on: a call repeated with nothing changing is refused; past half the limits below an agent is told to wrap up, past them every tool is refused and it reports what it did; off: no limit. /changes guard overrides it

guardMinutes.title: Guard: minutes per turn
guardMinutes.description: The hard limit on one turn of an agent, in minutes of its own work (time a person is asked is left out); the soft one is half

guardSteps.title: Guard: tool calls per turn
guardSteps.description: The hard limit on one turn of an agent, in tool calls; the soft one is half

routerUseModel.title: Route with a model
routerUseModel.description: Where none of your rules fits, ask a small model which skill fits the prompt (about a second per prompt)

routerModel.title: Model for routing
routerModel.description: The model that picks the skill: an alias like haiku or a full model id
